author: FunForLouis
description:
Support us on Patreon... https://bit.ly/RayaandLouisPatreon

I surprised my dad with a trip to China, and in this first vlog we kick things off in Chengdu with room-service robots, a wild light show on the Twin Towers and a visit to the giant panda conservation centre. Then we catch a bullet train into the mountains and spend a day exploring Jiuzhaigou National Park, with turquoise lakes and some of the most spectacular waterfalls I’ve ever seen. We round off the adventure watching a traditional Tibetan folk dance around a bonfire, where my dad gets to throw a wish into the fire.
